How it works

Select a system for its owner and handoff.

Systems, ownership and access
Form + data extension

Field definitions, capture wording and source-row status belong to the SFMC form and data extension configuration.

HTTP sender

A sender asset formats and sends the source rows. Its endpoint, retry schedule and acknowledgement updates live in SFMC settings.

HTTP receiver

The deployed receiver validates the request and uses a stable identity to find existing work. A repository change must be deployed before this behavior changes.

Durable receipt

A receipt remembers which downstream steps completed. Retry an incomplete step without creating a second opportunity.

Recovery timer

Application recovery is a separate scheduler from SFMC source retries. Both must preserve the same submission identity.

SharePoint routing

A managed list can replace a legacy Excel lookup. Label the source actually read by the application.

Owner: Sales operations

Access: SharePoint list owner + runtime application grant

Notification outbox

Notification failure does not undo a saved opportunity. Delivery callbacks update the existing outbox record.

Contact + opportunity

CRM records need a business-approved campaign and routing rule. Record permissions and administration are separate.

Owner: Sales / CRM owner

Access: Dynamics security-role administrator

Owner notification

A durable record and a delivered notification are distinct outcomes. Observe delivery before claiming the owner was notified.

Rules and supporting detail

The handoff

Validate request
→
Save receipt
→
Match contact
→
Assign opportunity

The receiving endpoint checks authorization and required fields. It records the submission identity, matches or creates the contact, then creates an opportunity with a routing rule. A notification tells the assigned owner about the saved work.

BoundaryEvidence to keep
Form → receiverSubmission ID and validation result
Receiver → CRMReceipt linked to contact, opportunity, and owner
CRM → notificationDelivery attempt and final delivery status

When the last step fails

A failed notification does not erase a saved opportunity. Retry the incomplete step using the existing receipt. Replaying the entire submission without a stable identity can create duplicate records or notify the wrong owner.

What this browser demo actually does

The example keeps state in memory. It does not accept real form data, authenticate to a CRM, create records, or send messages. Reloading the page resets it.
